title: HideModded Continued
description: Removes the asterisk in the title bar and Modded-tag in the main menu of Minecraft
body:
[![github](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/github_vector.svg)](https://github.com/DavidCGranger/HideModded-Continued)

From 1.15.2, if the game is modified, "(Modded)" will appear after the main menu game version number and "*" will appear in the game title bar.

This mod hides the "*" in the title bar of the game and the "(Modded)" after the game version number in the main menu.

This mod will **not** hide your mods from servers!

This is a fork of [CiiLu](https://modrinth.com/user/CiLu)'s [original mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/hidemodded) that updates it to support 26.1 and later. The original source code can be found [here](https://github.com/CiiLu/HideModded).

The original mod should be used for 1.21.11 and earlier.

![Screenshot](https://github.com/DavidCGranger/HideModded-Continued/blob/master/screenshot.png?raw=true)
